The check count in a receipt is self-reported, so an eight-line stub printing a passing receipt satisfied the floor and the whole gate went green. Under a workflow that invokes the authentic harness/ci-gate pair, this binding detects an isolated suite or runner replacement that merely claims to have run. It is not independent attestation against an in-repository workflow edit that bypasses those runners; reviewer diff inspection or an externally administered required workflow remains that trust root. Update an entry in the same commit that changes its tool, and review the diff: this file is authored, never generated from whatever is on disk.
